title: Baby Sitting on Car Hood with Teddy Bear, 1950s Vintage Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A charming black-and-white candid snapshot from the late 1950s capturing 10-and-a-half-month-old Sandra Lee happily seated on the hood of a vintage family car next to her stuffed animal. The top margin includes handwritten blue ink reading 'Sandra Lee 10 1/2 mos.', showcasing typical mid-century family photography practices of documenting childhood milestones.
